title: SMALLINT alert_rule column too narrow for int64 model field
answers: Missing series resolution count above 32767 fails to save
alert rule numeric field errors or truncates on MySQL/Postgres above SMALLINT max
int64 model field but DB column is too small
body:
Symptom: setting an alert rule's missing-series resolution count above 32,767 fails or errors on MySQL/PostgreSQL, even though the Go model field is int64.
Root cause: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go originally created alert_rule.missing_series_evals_to_resolve and alert_rule_version.missing_series_evals_to_resolve as SMALLINT, narrower than the int64 Go field.
Fix pattern: add a new migration using migrator.NewRawSQLMigration("").Mysql(...).Postgres(...) with dialect-specific ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY/ALTER COLUMN ... BIGINT statements (see ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve), rather than editing the original AddColumn migration.
Constraints: applies whenever a DB column backing an int64 (or otherwise wide) Go model field was originally created with a narrower SQL type; must widen both the base table and its paired *_version table.
applies: Grafana alerting DB schema (alert_rule / alert_rule_version) and similarly modeled tables with narrow numeric columns
